text: This report recommends that the name "Nicastro Lane" be approved to identify an existing public lane located north of Eglinton Avenue West, extending between Marlee Avenue and Fairleigh Crescent. Community Councils have delegated authority to decide street naming matters which comply with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy .
North York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Nicastro Lane" for an existing public lane north of Eglinton Avenue West, extending between Marlee Avenue and Fairleigh Crescent.
